claims: As of late March 2026, 30-year fixed mortgage rates are hovering around 6.25% to 6.49%
30-year fixed mortgage rates ticked upward from February 2026 lows
February 2026 lows for 30-year fixed mortgage rates briefly dipped below 6%
The 15-year fixed mortgage rate is currently averaging roughly 5.75% to 5.82%
As of March 26-27, 2026, 30-year fixed mortgage rates are ~6.38% to 6.625% according to averages, bank-specific rates, Freddie Mac, and Bank of America
As of March 26-27, 2026, 15-year fixed mortgage rates are ~5.75% according to Freddie Mac and Bank of America
As of March 26-27, 2026, FHA 30-year mortgage rates are ~6.03% to 6.25% according to Bankrate and Consumers CU
As of March 26-27, 2026, jumbo 30-year mortgage rates are ~6.27% to 6.63% according to Bankrate
CBS News says rates have increased in March after dropping below 6% in late February
Freddie Mac reports the 30-year fixed average rose from 6.22% last week to 6.38% this week
Freddie Mac notes rates are still generally lower than the same period a year ago
